title: Figure 13. Atlas IIAS Simulation Results with B = 5,000,000
description: Semi-log line graph titled in-plot "Atlas IIAS Random-Attitude Failures through 280 sec," plotting "Percent in 5-deg sector (%)" against "Angle From Flight Path (deg)." Simulated impact distributions for no breakup and breakup q-alphas of 20,000, 10,000 and 5,000 deg-lb/ft^2 are compared with theoretical curves for B = 5,000,000 and A = 4.75, 5.65, 6.10 and 6.30.
